molly (Docs): Heads-up: found two issues in /v1/chat/completions API docs — example response shows a top-level "result" array instead of "choices", and the Python snippet still uses the old openai.* client call. Need a quick patch before tomorrow's release.

sam (SDK): Oof. Thanks for catching. Can you paste the broken snippet and the expected shape? I'll update Python + JS snippets if it's just schema + call name.

molly (Docs): Broken example from the page:```json
{
  "id": "cmpl-abc123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "result": [
    {
      "text": "Hey!"
    }
  ]
}```Expected canonical response for chat/completions:```json
{
  "id": "cmpl-abc123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "Hey!"
      }
    }
  ]
}```Also the Python snippet is using `openai.Completion.create(...)` instead of the new `client.chat.create(...)` pattern we ship in SDK examples.

sam (SDK): Got it. I'll open a docs PR and update the code blocks + snippets. Do we also want a short migration blurb for customers who used the old example?

lee (Product): Yes — add a short migration note: mention older example fields (result/text) => new fields (choices/message/content), and link to the migration guide. Keep it 1-2 lines with an example mapping.

molly (Docs): Drafted a line: "Note: legacy examples used a top-level \"result\" array with \"text\" fields. New chat completions return \"choices[].message.content\"; update your parsing accordingly. See /docs/migrations/chat-response-shape for examples." Will paste small mapping snippet in the PR.

ana (Eng): @molly dropping in — can you also add a JSON schema sample so our linters can pick it up? I can add a tiny JSON Schema snippet to the docs folder if helpful.

molly (Docs): Good call — I'll add a compact schema block.

ana (Eng): Running a quick integration against staging to ensure real responses match the example. Starting now.

deploy-bot: docs-build: queued (job 4921)

deploy-bot: docs-build: started (job 4921)

an a (Eng): Staging responses look good, shape matches "choices[].message.content". No extra wrappers.

deploy-bot: docs-build: succeeded (job 4921) — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai/chat/completions

sam (SDK): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — updates: response examples, Python + JS snippets, small migration note, and added JSON Schema. Requesting review from @molly (Docs) and @lee (Product).

molly (Docs): Reviewing now. Quick nit: in the Python snippet change `response.choices[0].message.content` in the example code comment so it's explicit.

sam (SDK): Will update. Anything else?

lee (Product): Optional: add a tiny changelog bullet under "Docs updates" for this week so customers see the fix post-release.

molly (Docs): Done — added a one-liner. Approving once CI green. :thumbsup:

sam (SDK): Updated per comments, pushed commit. CI green. Merging after you approve @molly.

molly (Docs): Approved and merged. Thanks all.

sam (SDK): Follow-up task: create a small unit test to assert that our example JSON in docs matches the SDK output shape. Filed ticket infra#771.

molly (Docs): Great — closing thread. If anything else pops up ping #docs. :sparkles:
